title: smilax bona-nox var. horrida
intro: Smilax bona-nox var. horrida, commonly known as "Cayenne or Wild Sarsaparilla", is a plant species that belongs to the Smilacaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Smilax bona-nox var. horrida include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
